items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Zweckentfremdung permit
items.quote: Ihr Widerspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheides an das Bezirksamt Musterelbe, Elbhangweg 8, 22765 Hamburg, zu richten, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Bescheid dated Tue 21.04.2026, sent as simple letter. Per § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG it is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 21.04 (day0, posting) -> 22.04 (1) -> 23.04 (2) -> 24.04 (3) -> 25.04.2026 (4th day) = Saturday. Since the 4th day falls on a Saturday, deemed delivery shifts to the next business day, Monday 27.04.2026 (no intervening Hamburg holiday). The one-month Widerspruch period then runs under §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: it starts the day after the deemed-delivery event (27.04.2026) and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 27.05.2026. 27 May 2026 is a Wednesday (no weekend/holiday extension needed), so the deadline stands at that date.
